description: This file defines the MailHandler class, a custom Monolog handler for sending emails using a Mail object, with support for delayed sending and message templating.

classes.name: Goteo\Util\Monolog\Handler\MailHandler
classes.description: Custom Monolog handler for sending emails via Goteo's Mail class, with support for delayed sending and message templating.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MailHandler with a Mail object, message, level, delay option, and bubble setting.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Builds the email message and sends it immediately if not delayed.

methods.name: setDelayed
methods.description: Sets whether email sending should be delayed.

methods.name: isDelayed
methods.description: Checks if email sending is currently delayed.

methods.name: sendDelayed
methods.description: Sends the email if delayed and content exists, then resets delay.

methods.name: doSending
methods.description: Performs the actual sending of the email, including appending extra info and error handling.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Creates the email message, using a callable template if provided.
